confidence.head: discriminant
confidence.text: For the head `discriminant`, the scale was set on the tuning photos (expected calibration error 0.084 there). A species is named when its probability is at least 0.81, the lowest level from which named species were right at least nine times in ten on the tuning photos; three species are offered when the first three together reach 0.96, set the same way. On the test photos a species is then named for 25.8% (24.6 to 27.2) of photos and that name is right for 88.3% (86.4 to 90.2) of them; three species are offered for 4.7% (4.1 to 5.3) and hold the right one for 90.3% (86.2 to 94.4); 69.5% (68.1 to 70.9) get a kind of eye only. These figures leave out the page's rule that names and offers must agree with the winning kind; the exported slot is scored with that rule.
